configure_lfs_multipart_upload: configure a local git repository to use the multipart transfer agent for large files
run_lfs_multipart_upload: run the git-lfs custom transfer agent for multipart uploads of large files to Hugging Face Hub
write_lfs_message: write a line-delimited JSON message to stdout for the git-lfs transfer protocol
read_lfs_message: read a line-delimited JSON message from stdin for the git-lfs transfer protocol
enable_largefiles_in_repo: enable largefile support in a local git repository by configuring git-lfs multipart transfer
